title: Distinguished completions with the compatible relative Mayer--Vietoris boundaries
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Assume S,S′ affine and f quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let K∈D_QCoh(O_X), K′∈D_QCoh(O_X′), and φ:L(g′)K→K′ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let U,V cover X with U,V and U∩V quasi-compact. Fix the source and target pair-of-unit and difference-of-restriction maps of [def-pc-relative-mv-maps], on the sources and targets of the specified canonical local arrows. There exist boundaries δ from the source overlap term to the shifted global source and δ′ from the target overlap term to the shifted global target, completing these fixed two-arrow sequences to distinguished triangles [def-weil-triangulated-category]. The connecting square δ≫αX[1]=α(U∩V)≫δ′ commutes. Neither of the two restriction squares nor a morphism of triangles is asserted.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-relative-mv-ses-presentation to obtain two short exact complexes, their morphism, and comparisons of vertices and first two arrows.

Construct both boundaries as the conjugates of DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ. Mathlib triangleOfSES_distinguished and Triangle.isoMk transport distinguishedness. Apply triangleOfSESδ_naturality, shift the first component identity, and cancel the overlap isomorphism to get the boundary equation.

theorem relativeMV_boundary_completion
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S'] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let a := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let aX := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (δ : (a (U ⊓ V)).left ⟶ aX.left⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (δ' : (a (U ⊓ V)).right ⟶ aX.right⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk (relativeMVSourceFirst f g U V K)
        (relativeMVSourceSecond f g U V K) δ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory S') ∧
      Triangle.mk (relativeMVTargetFirst g' f' U V K')
        (relativeMVTargetSecond g' f' U V K') δ' ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory S') ∧
      δ ≫ aX.hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = (a (U ⊓ V)).hom ≫ δ'
